name: compinche
description: Capture how someone cooks. Learn to make it their way. A mobile-first cooking companion with a local LangGraph agent, Meta and SAM.

scripts.prestart: node -e "if (!require('node:fs').existsSync('backend/.venv/bin/python')) { console.error('Set up the Python environment first: python3 -m venv backend/.venv && backend/.venv/bin/python -m pip install -r backend/requirements.lock.txt. See README.md for Windows instructions.'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.check: node --check dist/app.js && node --check dist/api.js && node --check dist/capture.js && node --check dist/data.js && node --check dist/icons.js
